# Woo et al.

Woo et al. is cited as a research source in the AFDK program's documentation on structured patient education for atrial fibrillation. This is a thin entry: the name appears once in the corpus, referenced alongside McCabe (2011) as supporting literature for the recommended content of patient education under the ABC Pathway framework [^src1]. No further biographical, institutional, or relational details about Woo et al. are available in the source material.

The citation appears within AFDK's documentation of Indicator 8 (Structured patient education), which sets out what information patient education for atrial fibrillation should contain, adapted to each patient's situation [^src1]. No further details are available.

## Mentions

- Page 100: "I relation til The ABC Pathway anbefaler AFDK, at patientundervisningen bør indeholde informationer listet i nedenstående tabel tilpasset den enkelte patients situation (McCabe, 2011; Woo et al., 2021)" [^src1]
